== Summary ==
PC Errata 2013 slip image of [[Blaster Rifle (PC Errata 2013 slip)]]: PC Errata 2013 slip (Players Committee errata slip, text as of 1 January 2013).

Source: Players Committee, ''Decipher Errata'' sheet (“Official text as of January 1, 2013”), [http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf DecipherErrata.pdf], PDF page 31; the PDF was made on 16 April 2013 (file metadata). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160809094140/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf Internet Archive] (9 August 2016; SHA-1 of the archived file 3453cd4bee7d22faa58e3cfa492bea8021b2578c).

Uploaded unchanged (SHA-1 <code>a7dc51f253f3e68fe2560003c83580af98aea91c</code>).

Fair use rationale: a low-resolution image of a Star Wars CCG card or errata slip (© Decipher Inc. / Players Committee, Star Wars © Lucasfilm Ltd.), used only to identify and study the card's errata on this non-commercial fan wiki; no free equivalent exists.
